controls.columns_shuffled: per-package: <method>__released = false, <method>__shuffled = true (seed 20261010 + crc32(file name); graph mapped back before scoring)

orientation_rule: undecided pairs oriented at random with seed crc32(file name) (CausalArena Appendix B.2/B.4); the adjacency in predictions/*.npz is that oriented graph; committed arrows and undecided pairs are stored beside it
shd_variant: one per unordered pair whose predicted arrows differ from the true arrow(s) (REP-06)

metric_defs.directed_f1: summary.csv f1: F1 over directed edges after the orientation rule
metric_defs.nshd: shd / (d (d - 1) / 2); our definition, the CausalArena template does not define it
metric_defs.seconds: summary.csv runtime_sec: wall time of the method call on one file

note: Nothing here has been submitted. status timeout/failed rows leave graph metrics blank (allowed by the summary schema); our own family means score those files as empty graphs. Families present per package are listed in each manifest.json (row_sources, families_missing).
